shipped.no_dependency: nothing installed; the burst/field structure is copied in the sense the owner ruled (参考它的结构源代码进行复制), so no license record, no SBOM row and no remote reference is added
shipped.surface: canvas.motion-particles mounted as the first child of .app at z-index var(--layer-canvas-ambient), position:fixed, pointer-events:none, aria-hidden=true
shipped.paint: 24 particles, only the two brand inks #EEF2F5 and #17212B, alpha 0.10-0.22, drawn under every panel so no glyph composites over a particle
shipped.activation: off by default; ?motion=enhanced&particles=static paints one deterministic seeded frame (also the low-performance fallback the pack asks for), particles=live animates it, prefers-reduced-motion mounts nothing

pose_pass.note: enhanced face (?motion=enhanced) frozen at each keyframe pose, measured by the same MEASURE predicate as every other face

gate_bites: the audit now fails if the particle canvas is not mounted and aria-hidden for the enhanced URL, and fails if the product stops writing data-motion itself -- so the layer cannot exist only in source while the screen never shows it
not_claimed: the animated (live) variant has not been frame-certified for contrast; only its deterministic first pose has been measured. No human visual acceptance. No library was installed, so the rights/SBOM question stays unopened by choice.
